correctness.rationale: For unit harmonic oscillator, position/velocity Strang maps A=[[d,hc],[-h,d]], B=[[d,h],[-hc,d]], with d=1−h²/2,c=1−h²/4, have unit determinants and trace 2−h² in (−2,2) for 0<h<2, hence fixed powers bounded. Independent symbolic calculation gives (AᵀA+BᵀB)/2=(1+h⁶/32)I, proving exact all-n fair expected physical energy and time scale n h⁶. For arbitrary interior p, the 3D covariance determinant det(I−T_p)=−h⁸p(1−p)(8−h²)²/128<0; positivity gives a growing mean-square covariance mode (not every deterministic start or almost-sure growth). For deterministic alternating AB, the trace is 2−4h²+h⁴−h⁶/16; unimodularity and crossing tr=-2 at h=sqrt(5)−1 with AB≠−I establish bounded, Jordan, expanding regimes. SymPy verified polynomial identities independently; no extrapolation from finite h tests.
